text.p: Simon DeBartolo Group Inc said it consolidated its existing corporate credit facilities into one $750 million unsecured, revolving credit facility.
The facility matures in September 1999 and contains a one year extension at the company's option.
The new facility initially bears interest at LIBOR plus 90 basis points as compared to 132.5 basis points and 175 basis points on its previous unsecured and secured facilities, respectively.

Included in the credit facility is a money market competitive bid option program that allows Simon DeBartolo to hold auctions for short term funds for up to $150 million. The average blended rate on the first auction for $150 million of debt outstanding was LIBOR plus 72.5 basis points.
Simon DeBartolo is a real estate investment trust, which owns or has an interest in 183 properties including regional malls, community shopping centers, and specialty and mixed-use properties.
